_note: Texts of the player's controls in a watched race (GDD 4.3.1, step R3): the pause cards (title, text, answers), the lines the player's choices put in the commentary (R4 turns the commentary into data/race_commentary.json), and the coach's shouts. Placeholders in {braces} are filled by the race: {pos} your place, {to_go} metres to go, {name} / {leader} a runner, {gap} metres, {call} 'Bell!' or 'Halfway!', {split} / {leader_split} times, {what} kicks / surges, {where} where they are, {context} a sentence about the move that is going. The card ids and the answer ids are used by scripts/core/race.gd.

break.title: Break from the lanes
break.text: The field cuts in to the inside lane. Where do you want to run?

options.label: Take the lead
options.detail: Control the pace from the front. Costs energy, but no traffic.

options.label: Sit on the leader's shoulder
options.detail: Stay close in 2nd–3rd, ready to react.

options.label: Tuck in at the back
options.detail: Save energy behind everyone. Risk of getting boxed in later.

options.label: Push the pace
options.detail: Run the second lap harder. Good if you're strong, risky if not.

options.label: Hold your position
options.detail: Keep doing what you're doing.

options.label: Ease off a little
options.detail: Save energy for the kick.

fall.title: You went down!
fall.text: You're back on your feet, {gap} m behind the pack. {to_go} m to go.

options.label: Get up and chase
options.detail: Run hard to get back on. Costs a lot of energy and may not be enough.

options.label: Finish steady
options.detail: Shake it off, run calmly and bring it home.

options.label: Kick now
options.detail: A long sprint for home. Strong finishers love this.

options.label: Wait for the home straight
options.detail: Kick with 100 m to go. Needs a fast finish and a clear path.

box.title: Boxed in
box.text: You're stuck behind {name} with a runner on your shoulder. {context} How do you get out?

options.label: Wait for a gap
options.detail: Stay put. A gap often opens, but you may be too late for the move.

options.label: Ease and step out
options.detail: Reliable, but you lose a few metres.

options.label: Push through
options.detail: The quickest way, but risk of contact, and a small risk of disqualification for obstruction.

options.label: Go with them
options.detail: Sit on them and cover the move. Costs energy now.

options.label: Let them go
options.detail: Stay patient and trust your own kick. They may pay for it later.

options.label: Counter-attack
options.detail: Hit back and go past them. Costs a lot, and only pays if you have plenty left.

straight.title: Home straight
straight.text: {name} is right in front of you.

options.label: Swing wide and go round
options.detail: A clear path, but a few extra metres.

options.label: Wait for a gap on the inside
options.detail: Shortest way, if a gap opens...

dropped.title: You're losing contact
dropped.text: The runners in front are pulling away: {gap} m to {name}. You're {pos}, {to_go} m to go.

options.label: Dig in
options.detail: Hang on to them now. It costs energy you would want later.

options.label: Run your own pace
options.detail: Let them go and keep your energy for a later kick.

slow.title: A slow pace
slow.text: Nobody wants to lead and the pace is slow. You're {pos}, {gap} m behind {leader}.

options.label: Take the lead
options.detail: Pick it up yourself. Costs energy, but the race is yours to shape.

options.label: Stay put
options.detail: Save energy and let the others make the first move.

says.break.shoulder: You settle on the leader's shoulder.
says.break.back: You tuck in at the back of the field.
says.bell.push: You push on down the back straight.
says.bell.ease: You ease off and save something for the finish.
says.move.wait: You let them go and stay patient.
says.dropped.dig: You dig in and hold on!
says.dropped.own: You settle into your own pace.
says.slow.lead: You take over at the front.
says.fall.chase: You scramble up and give chase!
says.fall.steady: You get up and carry on steadily.
says.kick.now: You kick with {to_go} m to go!
says.straight.wide: You swing wide into lane 2 and go for it!
says.straight.gap: A gap opens on the inside!
says.bar.move_out: You move out to find space.
says.bar.kick: You kick with {to_go} m to go!

break.back: Stay at the back, be patient!

box.wait: Be patient, a gap will come!

straight.inside: Stay inside, wait for the gap!
